summary: Frontend v2 validation completed: Metas & Comissão, Inventário multi-canal, and Contábil CSV export. Admin login works, all 9 nav items render (nav-dashboard/nav-crm intermittently missed in first querySelector snapshot due to render timing but visible in screenshot). Goals page renders KPIs, dialog opens with vendor/target/rate inputs. Inventory page renders WITHOUT any 'destroy is not a function' regression error - useEffect fix confirmed working. All 7 required default channels present (Mercado Livre, Shopee, Amazon Brasil, Magalu, Loja Matriz SP, Loja RJ Centro, E-commerce Próprio). CSV export returns 200 with correct Content-Type text/csv, Content-Disposition attachment, UTF-8 BOM (verified via curl), semicolon delimiter, exact PT-BR headers, and correct per-UF ICMS: SP=18.00%, RJ=22.00%, MA=22.00%. RBAC verified: vendedor user does NOT see new-goal-button, new-channel-button, new-inventory-button.
